To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the preparation of mesoporous γ-Al2O 3 is possible by a one-step sol-gelsynthesis, which is simple, rapid and reproducible, and that hierarchical alumina monolith with high surface areas can be prepared by a simple and scalable synthesis.

(i) a new simple, fast and one-step sol–gel method is described for the synthesis of highly porous γ-alumina; (ii) a new method for the synthesis of hierarchical alumina monolith is described; (iii) a comparison of the different preparation strategies for mesoporous alumine is given.

mesoporous aluminas can be prepared by different methods, but the best method for large scale production is the EISA method and the best method to obtain hierarchical meso-/macroporous alumina is the one-pot sol-gel method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of alumina materials featuring high porosity, high specific surface area and large pore volume.
the preparation and characterization of mesoporous γ-Al2O 3 materials and hierarchical alumina monolith materials.
the synthesis, characterization and application of mesoporous and hierarchical alumina.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most reproducible synthesis is the EISA method, but the most promising material for flow application is the hierarchical alumina monolith.

the synthesis of mesopore alumina by direct template synthesis is difficult to reproduce and scale-up, while the synthesis of meso-macroporous alumina monolithic materials is more reproducible and can be scaled-up.
the most reproducible method to obtain nanostructured mesopores in alumina is the sol-gel synthesis, but it is difficult to scale up.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of mesopores in alumina is not a difficult task but the synthesis of meso- and macro-porous alumina in monolithic shape remains a challenge.
the synthesis of mesoporus alumina materials is not easy, but can be done in an optimized way.
mesoporous aluminas can be synthesized with high efficiency by using a simple and fast sol-gel method, but the γ-Al2 O3 phase is obtained only after a high-temperature calcination step (800–1000 °C).
